message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a costume (My Melody) consisting of a dress and a hooded cape. Adult costumes made of textile are generally classified in 9505.90 as festive articles if they are not "wearing apparel" under the rules. CBP has often ruled that costumes of low-quality construction are classified in 9505.90.6000 (festive, carnival or other entertainment articles, other).

Note that Chapter 95 Note 1(e) excludes "fancy dress of textiles, of chapters 61 and 62". CBP has held that costumes made of flimsy materials, not durable, are classified in 9505.90.6000, whereas well-constructed ones go to Chapters 61/62. For adult-size costumes of a dress and cape, a ruling might say the dress is a pullover knit dress. If the garment is a knit dress with a cape, it could be a set classified in 6104.4x. But the description says "costume", and My Melody Darling is a Halloween costume. Many such rulings conclude 9505.90.6000, since the garments are of limited durability.

I'll go with 9505.90.6000.
